title: Electroplated coatings of silver for decorative and protective purposes
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard specifies requirements of six grades for electroplated coatings of silver for decorative and/or protective applications. It does not apply to coatings on screw threads, to coatings applied on sheet or strip in the unfa*bricated form.
